caption: Heavy curtains in a dim bedroom are pulled open, and daylight floods in and brightens the room.

sa.check: Heavy curtains hang in a dim bedroom.
Daylight floods in and brightens the room.
The brightest part is nearest the window.

pc.expect: The light enters through the widening gap and the room brightens as the curtains open, brightest nearest the window.
pc.fail: The room is bright with the curtains shut; or stays dim with them open; or the far wall is brightest.
The room brightens before the curtains move; or with them still; or it dims as they open.

pc.expect: The lit area grows as the gap widens.
pc.fail: It shrinks; or is full before the curtains move; or flickers.

pc.expect: The curtains are cloth that gathers as it is drawn.
pc.fail: They are rigid; or float; or pass through the rail.
A second window appears; or a curtain vanishes; or the light becomes solid.
Furniture rearranges; or the walls change colour; or the curtains change colour.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
